instructions.text: Rub generously with salt, smashed garlic and white pepper.
Coat the clams (scrubbed) in the marinade and rest at least 30 minutes (overnight is better).
instructions.tip: Marinating overnight gives the deepest flavour and colour.

instructions.text: Light a charcoal grill and let it burn down to glowing embers (or heat a grill pan).
Grill the clams over medium coals, turning and basting, until the shells open.
Serve with tuk trey p'aem — sweet-sour fish-sauce dip with chili and peanuts.
Serve with steamed rice and fresh herbs and cucumber.
